attributes.description: This tag represents the id of the pricebook for the product in transaction.
attributes.name: Pricebook

attributes.description: This Tag represents the Id of the Price Adjustment Schedule which has the volume based adjustments configured for the line item/ product in the transaction.
attributes.name: PriceAdjustmentSchedule

attributes.description: This tag represents the type of header discount being applied to the transaction , where it is of type Percentage amount or override.
attributes.name: HeaderDiscountType

attributes.description: This tag represents the value of header discount being applied to the transaction , for a given discount type.
attributes.name: HeaderDiscountValue

attributes.description: This tag represents the logic used to spread the header discount across line items , whether it is spread equally or proportionally.
attributes.name: HeaderDistributionLogic

attributes.description: This tag represents the type of header discount distribution or spread, whether is spread on net unit price or on line item total.
attributes.name: HeaderDistributionType

attributes.description: This tag represents the quantity of the line item/ product in the transaction.
attributes.name: Quantity

attributes.description: This tag represents the effective from date for the lone item to be considered for contract based pricing.
attributes.name: StartDate

attributes.description: This tag represents the count or number of pricing terms associated with the item, displayed as a numeric value.
attributes.name: PricingTermCount

attributes.description: This tag represents the unit price of the item in the transaction, displayed in the currency format.
attributes.name: UnitPrice

attributes.description: This tag represents the id of the product to be priced in the transaction , this is at a line item level.
attributes.name: Product

attributes.description: This tag represents the list price value fetched from the pricebook for the lineitem/ product in the transaction.
attributes.name: ListPrice

attributes.description: This tag represents the value of the line item's net total price.
attributes.name: NetTotalPrice

attributes.description: This tag represents the id of the ProductSelling Model (like one time , recurring etc) for the product in the transaction.
attributes.name: ProductSellingModel

attributes.description: This tag represents the term or duration of the subscription for the item, displayed as a numeric value.
attributes.name: SubscriptionTerm

attributes.description: This tag represents what is the selling model type of a product, values can be One time or recurring or term defined.
attributes.name: SellingModelType

attributes.description: This tag represents the group of SalesTransactionItems contributed towards CumulativeQuantities calculation.
attributes.name: AggregatedGroupId__std

attributes.description: This tag represents SalesTransactionItem is priced using CumulativeQuantity feature or not.
attributes.name: PriceItemUsingCumulativeQuantity__std

attributes.description: This tag represents whether or not a line item has contract based price , this is a boolean value.
attributes.name: IsContracted

attributes.description: This tag represents the Price Adjustment schedule Id which has the volume adjustments to be applied under Contract.
attributes.name: ContractVolumePasId

attributes.description: This tag represents the Contract Price Adjustment schedule to be considered when applying contract based product attribute discounts
attributes.name: ContractAttributePasId

attributes.description: This tag represents the contractual discount type (like percentage) to be applied on list price of a product
attributes.name: ContractDiscountType

attributes.description: This tag represents the contractual discount value of a given type to be applied on list price of a product
attributes.name: ContractDiscountValue

attributes.description: This tag represents the contract based price of a product , this can be a flat override price or a price arrived at after applying the contracted discount.
attributes.name: ContractPrice

attributes.description: This tag represents the floor price or the minimum price allowed for a line item by business, so as to prevent over discounting and loss of margins.
attributes.name: MinimumNetUnitPrice

attributes.description: This tag represents the group or category to which the sales transaction item belongs.
attributes.name: SalesTransactionItemGroup

attributes.description: This tag represents the last lowest price recorded for the line item for the duration of price tracking enabled.
attributes.name: ItemRecordedPrice

attributes.description: This tag represents the last lowest price recorded for the line item for the duration of price tracking enabled.
attributes.name: ItemMaxRecordedPrice__std

attributes.description: This tag represents the the net price per unit of the lineitem.
attributes.name: NetUnitPrice

attributes.description: This tag represents the total amount for the line item in the transaction, displayed in the currency format.
attributes.name: TotalLineAmount

attributes.description: This tag represents the main or primary product associated with the bundle ,displayed as text.
attributes.name: MainItemProduct

attributes.description: This tag represents the selling model or strategy associated with the bundle, displayed as text.
attributes.name: MainItemProductSellingModel

attributes.description: This tag represents the root product or base product associated when a line item is a bundle.
attributes.name: RootItemProduct

attributes.description: This tag represents the selling model or strategy associated with the root product of a bundle, displayed as text.Examples are One time , Recurring.
attributes.name: RootItemProductSellingModel

attributes.description: This tag represents whether the bundle is price inclusive , i.e. the child products are priced as zero since their price is included in the root bundle.
attributes.name: IsPriceInclusive

attributes.description: ProductRelationshipType from the ProductRelatedComponent record
attributes.name: ProductRelatedComponentPRT__std

attributes.description: This tag represents whether a product attribute is price impacting or not.
attributes.name: IsPriceImpacting

attributes.description: This tag represents the product attribute that should be considered for attribute based adjustment
attributes.name: AttributeName

attributes.description: This tag represents a single contributing line item or product , for a derived product.
attributes.name: Contributor

attributes.description: This tag represents the unit price of  the contributing product for a derived product.
attributes.name: ContributorUnitPrice

attributes.description: This tag represents the contributing product's overall price calculated.
attributes.name: ContributorTotalPrice

attributes.description: This tag represents the initial price set on the contributing product for a particular derived product.
attributes.name: ContributorListPrice

attributes.description: This tag represents whether the contributing product is within the current transaction or outside the transaction scope.
attributes.name: ContributorScope

attributes.description: This tag represents the source of information or data used by the contributor to determine the pricing of their product or service.
attributes.name: ContributorSource

attributes.description: This tag represents the formula applied on the contributing product to arrive at the derived product price.
attributes.name: ContributorFormulaInput

attributes.description: The tag represents the lower end of quantity of the line item/ product in the transaction above which the quantity based discounts configured for the product will be applied.
attributes.name: LowerBound

attributes.description: The tag represents the upper end of quantity of the line item/ product in the transaction below which the quantity based discounts configured for the product will be applied.
attributes.name: UpperBound
